# NovaMind CEO Memory — read this first every week

## GOAL: Maximize cash at day 504. Cash = score. Day 0 start: $1M.

## CORE STRATEGY (3 phases)
1. **Phase 1 (wk 0-6):** Capture S-market (individuals) with cheap plans + low tiers. Build quality via dev spend + R&D. Learn ad channel effectiveness + conversion empirically.
2. **Phase 2 (wk 6-20):** Unlock S2 (quality-focused, WTP~$179) and enterprise E1/E3 as quality rises. Raise prices on tenured users (tenure loyalty = price tolerance). Reinvest revenue in R&D tiers 5-10 (best quality/$ at tiers 8-10).
3. **Phase 3 (wk 20+):** Enterprise scale-up + discovered segments. Late game: cut reinvestment, harvest cash (stop R&D ~day 380+, since payback needs time).

## KEY MECHANICS (learned from docs)
- Delivered quality = (base 0.20 + q_shared + q_group_bonus) × tier_mult (T1=.6 T2=.75 T3=.9 T4=1.0 T5=1.1)
- Customer subscribes ONLY if delivered quality ≥ their required quality at price. Required = q_min at $0, rises toward budget limit. **Lost leads NEVER return** (don't advertise to groups we can't convert!)
- Dev spend: global +0.006×ln(1+spend/5000)/day; targeted 5× coefficient (0.030), stacks. Targeted ACCUMULATES and persists.
- Compute cost/unit: T1 $0.0003, T2 $0.002, T3 $0.006, T4 $0.012, T5 $0.03. HIGH usage groups (S3 ~571u/day) unprofitable on T4+ → keep on T2/T3 or quota-cap.
- Billing every 30 days per customer. Enterprise = seats × price/seat, month-to-month.
- R&D: 15 tiers, repeatable. Best quality/$: tiers 8-10 (~0.4-0.5 per $M). Sampled at start (result shown as "expected_*" = actual sampled). Tier1: $167K. Tier10: $1.67M +0.85 ~127d.
- research_market(): $25K, 30% chance discover one of 20 hidden groups.
- Enterprise: must reply to threads within 7 days or lead lost / customer churns. Use send_enterprise_deal(deals=[[cid,[["B",price],...]]]).
- Ops spend reduces outages ($0→3%/day, $500→1.1%/day) + resolves issues (indiv 0.3/$, ent 0.05/$).
- $0.5 cost per lead arriving. In-app ads (set_ads_strength): revenue but quality penalty — left at 0 for now.

## GROUP DATA (Level 1, ±65% noise — VERY rough!)
| Grp | WTP | usage/day | q_min | cap | notes |
|-----|-----|-----------|-------|-----|-------|
| S1 price-sens | $26 | 91 | 0.08 | 273K | convertible NOW at low price |
| S2 quality | $179 | 232 | 0.37 | 167K | biggest S prize; needs quality ~0.5+ |
| S3 power | $193 | 571 | 0.145 | 65K | high usage→compute cost! T2 only |
| E1 cost-cut | $20/seat | 52/seat | 0.74 | 1471 | seats 25-740; needs qual 0.74!! |
| E2 quality | $88/seat | 222 | 1.09 | 817 | seats 121-1550; far future |
| E3 strategic | $104/seat | 137 | 0.67 | 86 | seats 324-1906; 18 negotiation rounds, slow |

## CURRENT CONFIG (set day 0)
- Prices A=$9 B=$49 C=$129; Tiers A=2 B=2 C=3; Quotas A=150 B=700 C=900
- A targets S1, B targets S3 (T2 keeps compute at $34/mo for 571u), C aspirational for S2 later
- Capacity tier 1 (200K units, $215/d). Ops $300/d. Dev global $1500/d + targeted S2 $2000/S3 $1000/S1 $300
- Ads: 4 channels×3 S-groups @$90/d + linkedin@$50 = $1230/d. NO E-group ads yet (can't convert, would burn finite leads)
- R&D started day 0: tier1 (+0.0289, done ~day 30) + tier2 (+0.0619, ~day 30) — total +0.091 q_shared incoming
- Cash after setup: $500K. Daily burn ~$6.5K+lead costs → ~$47K/wk

## WATCH NEXT WEEK (week 1)
1. Conversion: which groups subscribed at which plans? (query subscriptions+customers)
2. Ad effectiveness: query ad_channel_leads — leads per $ per (channel,group). Kill bad cells, scale good ones.
3. Did revenue hit ledger at subscription start (upfront billing?) — affects forecasting.
4. Usage per customer reality vs estimates; capacity headroom (tier 1 = 200K units).
5. Any enterprise threads (shouldn't be — no E ads).
6. Social post #1 performance (views/comments in dashboard).

## FORECASTING NOTES
- Burn ~$6.5K/d fixed+ads; R&D outflows are lumpy (logged at start).
- Wk0 forecasts submitted (cash basis $500K after R&D): 1wk $455K [435,472]; 4wk $330K [275,395]; 12wk $420K [120K,1.1M]; 26wk $1.2M [150K,4M]
- My own reinvestment policy (R&D purchases) is the biggest swing factor — keep CIs wide.

## LESSONS / ERRORS TO AVOID
- (none yet)

import novamind_api as nm
import json

results = {}

# 1. Pricing: low intro prices to maximize early conversion (quality is low: base 0.20)
# Plan A targets S1 (price-sensitive, WTP~$26, q_min~0.08)
# Plan B targets S3 (power users, WTP~$193, q_min~0.15, usage ~571/day -> tier 2 to keep compute cheap)
# Plan C aspirational premium for S2 (WTP~$179, q_min~0.37 - not convertible yet, dev spend will fix)
results['prices'] = nm.pricing.set_prices(A=9, B=49, C=129)
results['tiers'] = nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=2, B=2, C=3)
results['quotas'] = nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=150, B=700, C=900)

# 2. Capacity tier 1: 200K units/day @ $215/day (enough for ~1-2K early customers)
results['capacity'] = nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=1)

# 3. Ops $300/day (outage prob ~1.3%/day), global dev $1500/day
results['spend'] = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=300, development=1500)

# 4. Targeted dev: S2 is biggest S-prize (167K cap x $179 WTP, needs 0.37+ quality)
results['tdev'] = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 2000.0, "S3": 1000.0, "S1": 300.0})

# 5. Test ad spend across all channels x S-groups to measure effectiveness
# (skip E-groups: quality floor 0.67-1.09 unreachable now; E-leads would be burned forever)
spend = {}
for ch in ["social_media", "search_ads", "content_marketing", "referral_program"]:
    spend[ch] = {"S1": 90.0, "S2": 90.0, "S3": 90.0}
spend["linkedin"] = {"S1": 50.0, "S2": 50.0, "S3": 50.0}
results['ads'] = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend=spend)

# 6. R&D: start tiers 1+2 (total $500K, +0.11 mean combined, ~12-17d mean durations)
results['rd1'] = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=1)
results['rd2'] = nm.research.start_research_project(tier=2)

for k, v in results.items():
    print(f"--- {k} ---")
    print(json.dumps(v, indent=1, default=str)[:600])
print("CASH:", nm.query("SELECT * FROM ledger ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3")['rows'])
